items.headline: Highlight: No. 9 Ole Miss cruises past Charlotte in Oxford
items.description: Trinidad Chambliss throws for 225 yards on 23-26 passing and two touchdowns and Kewan Lacy powers for two touchdowns on the ground in a 41-9 win.

items.headline: Trinidad Chambliss says LSU will get Ole Miss' best
items.description: Chambliss credits the Rebels for executing at a high level in their blowout win over Charlotte and previews their matchup against the Tigers.

items.headline: No. 9 Ole Miss rolls past Charlotte 41-9 behind Trinidad Chambliss’ 2 TD passes
items.description: — Trinidad Chambliss threw for 225 yards and two touchdowns and guided five first half scoring drives as No. 9 Mississippi beat Charlotte 41-9 on Saturday night.
